definition.evidence: example_exports/gls_exported/pixel/dx_5_0/uber (12.1.0 client, all 26 variants): the switch on cb2[4].x that sets diffuse and emissive, and the alpha-test switch that sets alpha

t0.description: The material's texture 1, sampled at uv0 unless the draw's environment-mapping flag (cb0[5].y = 1 or 2) replaces it with sphere-mapped coordinates.

t2.description: The material's texture 3, sampled at uv0 unless the draw's environment-mapping flag (cb0[5].y = 1 or 2) replaces it with sphere-mapped coordinates.

definition.notes: 2*t1.rgb replaces the baked vertex light (v3.rgb times a per-draw scale, cb8[8].w, in every other shader). t1 and t2 are sampled at the first uv, not their own. Alpha is what the shader alpha-tests (128/255, per MSAA sample).
